finding: the codex/seat-r001 branch carries an emphatic claim that main verified against primary source and WITHDREW
scope: Compares one arc_verdict across two branches. Does not re-derive B-L, does not adjudicate the frame question -- main's B1144 did that against primary source and this seat accepts it. Gate 5 untouched.
the_exact_inversion: The branch says 'a load-bearing error, NOT a convention slip'. Main says 'a frame difference ... NOT a cloud error'. These are not merely different emphases -- each explicitly negates the other's category.
verdict: THE CODEX BRANCH CARRIES A WITHDRAWN CLAIM ABOUT ANOTHER SEAT'S CORRECTNESS, STATED IN THE STRONGEST AVAILABLE TERMS. On origin/codex/seat-r001, B1143's arc_verdict says banking the cloud's literal numbers 'would have been a FALSE POSITIVE on the one question that matters -- verify-don't-trust catching a LOAD-BEARING ERROR, NOT A CONVENTION SLIP', and the branch contains ZERO occurrences of the withdrawal. On origin/main the same arc, reframed by B1144, says that correction is WITHDRAWN as a CROSS-FRAME ARTIFACT -- a FRAME DIFFERENCE of the same adoption-layer class as the Q(sqrt-3) basis slip, NOT A CLOUD ERROR, verified in golden_gate primary source. Each statement explicitly negates the other's category. THE CODEX SEAT'S METHOD WAS RIGHT AND ITS SIGNAL WAS REAL -- the literal numbers genuinely fail in B1139's frame, and verify-don't-trust caught that. Only the diagnosis was wrong. This is a branch-currency problem, not a failure of the seat that found it, and it matters more than ordinary headline drift for four reasons: it is an assertion about another seat's correctness rather than about mathematics; it is stated so as to pre-emptively exclude the reading that turned out to be right; the seat is presumably still working from that branch; and any merge or read propagates a retracted accusation.
what_is_NOT_wrong: The codex seat's METHOD was right and produced a real signal: the literal numbers genuinely did not solve the construction in B1139's frame, and verify-don't-trust caught that. The mismatch was real. Only the DIAGNOSIS -- cloud error versus frame difference -- was wrong, and main's B1144 settled it against golden_gate primary source. This is a currency problem on a branch, not a failure of the seat that found it.
